records.title: Theranos diagnostic analyzer claims, evaluator failure and collapse
records.sourceNativeSummary: Theranos is retained as a failure trajectory in which product demonstrations and investor claims represented a broad finger-stick testing capability that, according to the SEC, the proprietary analyzer could not realize: it could perform only a small number of tests and most patient tests used modified or standard commercial analyzers.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Promotional representation, product-demo evidence, analyzer capability, patient-test realization and independent regulatory/clinical validation are separate historical objects; investor enthusiasm or a compelling measurement narrative does not establish diagnostic performance.

sourceBundle.title: SEC 2018 Theranos fraud charges
sourceBundle.supports: false/misleading technology claims, analyzer capability boundary and historical collapse

records.title: Kemper County coal-gasification/CCS route and gasifier suspension
records.sourceNativeSummary: Kemper is retained as an industrial-route failure/control: the combined-cycle unit entered commercial service on natural gas, while the intended lignite-gasification route remained troubled; in June 2017 the company suspended gasification start-up/operations and continued on natural gas, citing project economics.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Construction progress, natural-gas subsystem operation, carbon-capture/gasification design intent, economic viability and durable operation of the integrated coal route are distinct standings; operation of the gas plant did not realize the original integrated route.

sourceBundle.title: DOE Kemper County project status
sourceBundle.supports: project chronology, natural-gas operation and 2017 gasifier suspension/economic boundary

sourceBundle.supports: project governance/cost-management pressure and original demonstration objective
